title: lastrea viscosa
intro: Lastrea viscosa, commonly known as the sticky fern or creeping fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea viscosa include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions are primarily flavonoids and phenolic compounds, which also contribute to its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
